smokeTestNotes: Product and pricing pages reviewed in October 2026.
name: Veras
shortDescription: Turns a sketch, a floor plan, or a model view into a visualization. From $202.80 a year.
longDescription: Veras, from Chaos, turns a sketch, an image, or a prompt into a visualization, and it can turn a sketch, floor plan, or image into an editable 3D scene for Revit, Rhino, or SketchUp. It also renders from a 3D model inside Revit, SketchUp, Rhino, Archicad, Vectorworks, Forma, and Allplan. One license is $202.80 billed annually. Veras Pro is $29 a month billed annually at $348. A trial can create up to 4 scenes.
pricingNotes: One license is $202.80 billed annually. Veras Pro is $29 per month billed annually at $348. The trial can create up to 4 scenes.
